Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we keep alignment before the demo:

- Primary goal: validate low-latency inference at scale for user-facing personalization (p95 latency target ~50–80ms).
- Key success criteria you mentioned: throughput for 5k concurrent sessions, predictable cold-starts, and auditability for requests tied to tenant IDs.
- Main blockers to address in the demo: network egress patterns, KV cache warm-up, and SLOs around multi-tenant isolation.

Next step: we recommend a focused 30-minute product intro targeted at your infra + ops leads (brief architecture + live run of a sample inference trace). Can you share who needs to attend from your side and a couple of availability windows? If helpful, we can propose 2–3 time options that balance PST/ET for your team.

Attached: proposed agenda (high level) so folks know what to expect.

High-level attendees from our side: Vivek (sales/solution), Mina (runtime engineering), Grace (customer success).

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
